annotations.title: Semantic Topic Clustering & Subgraph Taxonomy Synthesizer

description: Discovers latent thematic clusters, subtopic branches, and conceptual relationships across document corpora. Use when structuring broad search results into distinct thematic silos or generating table of contents taxonomies; for tracking chronological milestones, use summarize_temporal_timeline instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'documents_or_queries' ('clustering_method' defaults to 'tf_idf_semantic_graph'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

clustering_method.description: Thematic clustering algorithm: TF-IDF semantic graph, centroid k-means, or hierarchical taxonomy.

documents_or_queries.description: Newline-separated list or JSON array of text snippets, queries, or article abstracts.

max_clusters.description: Maximum number of thematic cluster groups to partition data into.

name: cluster_topic_subgraphs

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for cluster_topic_subgraphs.

clusters.description: List of identified topic clusters with representative labels and member documents.

modularity_score.description: Clustering partition modularity metric indicating distinctness of clusters.

total_nodes.description: Total number of items successfully clustered into the taxonomy.
